title: Microsoft Outage updates: No ETA yet on full recovery, company says
summary: Microsoft services are beginning to come back online after a massive global outage left millions of users without access for nearly 18 hours
llm_summary: Microsoft confirmed that its global outage—affecting Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Azure and dozens of other services—has begun to resolve, but a full recovery timeline remains unknown. The disruption lasted nearly 18 hours, leaving millions of users unable to access critical tools. While many services are now back online, the company says it’s still working to restore everything completely.
